name: Fealty to the Realm
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, you become the monarch.
The monarch controls enchanted creature.
Enchanted creature attacks each combat if able and can't attack you.

needs.what: a static control-changing effect (Control Magic) whose affects is the attached permanent, with the controlling player given by a player spec rather than fixed to the Aura's controller: here whoever is currently the monarch controls the enchanted creature, so control follows the monarchy as it moves between players, and reverts when the Aura leaves or becomes unattached (or when there is no monarch)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_effects has no control-changing effect; the gain_control op is one-shot and its durations (permanent, until_end_of_turn, end_of_your_next_turn, as_long_as_you_control_source, while_source_on_battlefield) neither end when the Aura becomes unattached nor move control to a new monarch, and the is_monarch condition can only gate a static, not name who controls the creature
